ai_show_review.summary: Alligator‑driven blaze with wild organ and thunderous drums
ai_show_review.blurb: The set erupts with a blistering Alligator that segues into powerful Drums and returns for an intense reprise. Pigpen’s organ roars through the Caution → Feedback sequence while Jerry delivers pure electric guitar fury. The performance is short but high‑energy, showcasing the early Dead’s raw power.
ai_show_review.review: On May 18, 1968 at the Santa Clara County Fairgrounds the Grateful Dead delivered a compact yet ferocious set that still feels like a voltage surge decades later. After a thunderous drum burst, Jerry Garcia ignites an all‑out Alligator that rides on pure electricity—his tone is relentless and his solo feels like a bolt of lightning. The band then plunges into a wild organ‑driven Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) → Feedback run, with Ron "Pigpen" McKernan’s keyboards bashing the walls despite his vocals being buried in the mix. A second Alligator reprise after another drum surge caps the set, leaving the audience drenched in feedback and a single cymbal tap that fades into the night. Though only captured on audience tapes, the best‑sounding source (gd68-05-18.aud.jools.18216.sbeok.shnf) conveys enough grit to let every high‑energy moment shine.

best_recording.reason: Good‑quality audience tape that captures the Alligator sequences clearly and retains the raw energy of the night, making it the most listenable among the available recordings.

key_highlights: Alligator → Drums → Alligator reprise creates a volcanic peak.
Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks) → Feedback run showcases wild organ and feedback chaos.
Pigpen’s bashing organ keys add primal intensity despite muffled vocals.

band_performance.Jerry: Pure electricity on Alligator; tone unstoppable and high‑energy throughout the set.
band_performance.Bob: Incendiary ‘proletariat’ rant adds a memorable spoken moment; supports the wild vibe.
band_performance.Brent: Pigpen’s organ is bashing and wild, driving the Caution‑Feedback sequence even though his vocals are barely audible.
band_performance.Mickey: Mind‑bending drumming that launches into the Alligator and fuels the overall intensity.
band_performance.Billy: Powerful drum work that partners with Mickey to create thunderous transitions and a fierce post‑drum Alligator.
